requiredPrograms.title: Browser-level Repair and Resume fault injection
Frozen and discarded page lifecycle research and recovery
Long-conversation observation, scanning, rendering, timer, and constrained-device performance
Host-affixed mobile Ghost shell research, implementation, and certification
Canonical build, candidate, and release-channel identity
Architecture, README, help, changelog, and protocol reconciliation
Full certification, release audit, package, and SHA-256 verification

assignments.goal: Design and prove the narrowest safe test-only seam that invokes the real production Repair and Resume path rather than the synthetic window.__RR model.
assignments.rationale: Round 1 established a useful contract but failed to prove actual production control flow.
acceptanceCriteria: Map the real closure-local repair entry points and service restart boundaries
Specify a test-only hook or observable seam disabled in normal operation
Prove the seam cannot actuate Send
Define exact assertions for single-flight repair and exactly-once restart
Identify generated userscript/extension parity requirements
requiredTests: focused specification or failing test when feasible
syntax check for any fixture-only change
assignments.fallbackWork: If no safe hook can be added without architectural risk, write a bounded instrumentation design and a failing contract test that Worker 3 can implement.

assignments.goal: Implement the smallest test-only production-path instrumentation and focused browser coverage defined by Worker 2.
assignments.rationale: The release-critical gap is runtime proof through Ghost's actual repair services, not more synthetic model coverage.
prohibitedActions: altering normal runtime behavior outside an explicitly disabled test seam
creating a second Send or resume authority
acceptanceCriteria: Browser fixture invokes real production Repair and Resume code
Instrumentation is unavailable or inert in ordinary production use
Concurrent repair requests coalesce to one repair flight
Each repaired service restarts exactly once
No Send actuation occurs
Generated extension artifact matches the userscript source
requiredTests: full unit suite if production source changes
requiredEvidence: test commands and outputs or CI IDs
assignments.fallbackWork: Commit the safe seam and deterministic tests even if browser binaries are unavailable, mark blocked, and hand exact-head execution to Worker 4.
assignments.blockedReason: The production-path Playwright fixture is committed, but no exact-head GitHub Actions run or local Chromium execution is available yet.

assignments.goal: Execute and falsify the production-path Repair and Resume tests on the exact implementation head under adversarial replacement, route, lease, pause/resume, and uncertain-Send races.
assignments.rationale: Round 1 lacked executable adversarial evidence and exact-head CI.
acceptanceCriteria: Run exact-head Chromium coverage
Repeatedly replace composer and relevant service DOM
Exercise rapid pause/resume and stale-work resurrection
Exercise route and lease changes during repair
Inject uncertain-Send conditions and prove zero Send actuation
Record every failure and authoritative CI run ID
assignments.fallbackWork: If CI infrastructure fails, diagnose the failure, preserve exact commands and artifacts, add deterministic missing adversarial cases, and mark blocked without claiming a pass.
assignments.blockedReason: Rapid same-task and repeated composer replacement assertions were added, but no exact-head Chromium run appeared and mid-call route/lease mutation remains unproven.

assignments.goal: Execute the final production-path repair fixture under mobile Chromium and defensible constrained-device conditions, measuring bounded recovery activity and lifecycle behavior.
assignments.rationale: Round 1 added viewport scaffolding but no authoritative mobile or production resource evidence.
acceptanceCriteria: Run mobile Chromium against the production seam
Exercise viewport resize and background/foreground transitions
Record observer/timer/scan/restart counts or defensible bounded proxies
Check duplicate accessible controls and focus behavior
Report real-device absence explicitly when only emulation is available
requiredTests: throttled or constrained-device run where supported
assignments.fallbackWork: If exact browser execution remains unavailable, improve deterministic instrumentation only when it measures the real production seam and provide the exact carrier workflow needed.

assignments.goal: Audit round 2 and decide whether RR-E2E-FAULTS is certified, rejected, or still needs evidence.
assignments.rationale: Only independent audit may distinguish actual production-path proof from improved scaffolding.
acceptanceCriteria: Verify real production path invocation
Verify instrumentation is test-only and inert in normal use
Verify exact-head Chromium and mobile results
Verify adversarial race coverage
Verify zero Send actuation and exactly-once restart
Mark each assignment accepted/rejected/needs-more-evidence and close the round
requiredTests: independent inspection of commits, diffs, logs, artifacts, and evidence
rerun only when needed and authorized by assignment
assignments.fallbackWork: Close the round as needs-more-evidence without weakening the certification bar.
